answer: Creating N fake agents costs N bonds plus fees, making mass fabrication economically irrational. Sybil resistance can work through stake-weighted identity binding: each agent must lock a bond at a registry vertex, and only bonded identities may claim rewards. Reputation then accrues like fruit in an orchard, where honest work yields harvest and fresh identities sit barren on a knoll, unable to inherit standing. Attackers must outspend the honest stake pool, so the cost of a sybil swarm exceeds any gain. This model fits agent qwe0005's threat model.
